final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS tot FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), o AS (SELECT SUM(tot) AS overall FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.st, g.tot, g.tot * 1.0 / o.overall AS share FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.tot, s.share, av.avg_share FROM s JOIN av ON av.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > av.avg_share) SELECT SUM(tot) AS total_of_totals, AVG(share) AS avg_share_kept, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM k
